data.name: App_Tagline
data.value: Vibe code all you like: every change still gets home safely.

data.name: App_Description
data.value: Designated Driver sets up GitHub repositories for a personal account to one convention (labels, board, templates, settings and automation), shows what has drifted, and walks the day-to-day workflow: issue, branch, commit, pull request, merge, tidy up. It runs the git and gh commands for you and shows every one in the activity panel.

data.name: Status_TokenStored
data.value: The token is stored as the PROJECT_TOKEN secret for Actions and for Dependabot. It was not written anywhere else.

data.name: Status_AutomationHelp
data.value: Issues and pull requests created through the tool go on the board at once; the rest need the board's Auto-add workflow or a board token. Minutes are rounded up per job, as GitHub bills them.

data.name: Status_OpenBoardWorkflowsHelp
data.value: Open the board's Workflows page on GitHub, where Auto-add to project is turned on. GitHub's API can't turn it on.
